run_ESDatasetToSequence: run ESDatasetToSequence to convert documents into binary sequences with separators and save byte offsets
run_ESMergeSequences: run ESMergeSequences to merge all stage 1 sequences into a single big sequence file
run_ESRangeRemover: run ESRangeRemover to read documents and duplicate byte ranges and remove exact substring duplicates
create_prepare_doc: create prepare_doc to encode a document with a tokenizer and prepend rank and doc_id separators as binary
run_sequence_reader: run sequence_reader to iterate over binary sequence files and yield individual document byte chunks
